Johnpro Biotech (Taiwan) JP001/Siroquine in glioblastoma: registry record stale since May 2021 (status UNKNOWN), no posted results, no paper, press item or licensee (HebaBiz) news found in English searches. Cannot tell whether the trial completed; nothing public located.

KEYNOTE-522: Merck release of 29 Jul 2019 (opened via same-day trade coverage) said the pCR primary was met at interim analysis. pCR has no HR; the HR fields give the first public EFS HR (interim, not yet significant) from ESMO on 29 Sep 2019, and the registry PCD (Oct 2025) reflects final follow-up, hence a lag of about -6.2 years.

AGO-OVAR 2.29/ENGOT-ov34 final results at ASCO 2024 (LBA5501; coverage dated 2 June 2024, exact session day within the meeting not confirmed): neither co-primary endpoint met. HR columns give OS; PFS HR 0.87 (0.73-1.04). Registry lists primary completion as 2025-03-11, nine months after the presentation; JCO paper 2025-12-03.

Novocure topline press release (8-K exhibit 99.1) of 2 Dec 2024: PANOVA-3 met OS, mOS 16.20 vs 14.16 mo, HR 0.819, p=0.039, no CI given. CI (HR 0.82, 95% CI 0.68-0.99) first seen in the JCO paper / ASCO 2025 presentation on 2025-05-31 (PMID 40448572).

OBI Pharma (Taiwan) GLORIA: material-information announcement of 23 Apr 2025 said the DSMB recommended stopping after the second interim analysis (113 of 187 events) and the company ended the trial; no efficacy numbers given and the full text on the company site is password-protected, so "futility" rests on Taiwanese press wording. Registry still shows ACTIVE_NOT_RECRUITING.

GSK headline-results RNS (filed as 6-K) of 20 Dec 2024: FIRST-ENGOT-OV44 met PFS, OS key secondary not significant, no numbers. HR first shown at ASCO 2025 (LBA5506); sources disagree whether the session was 1 or 2 June 2025, earliest coverage opened is dated 2 June; same HR later posted on ClinicalTrials.gov (2025-12-31).

NILE: no stand-alone press release found; the result first appears as a "new disclosure" in the pipeline table of AstraZeneca's H1/Q2 2026 results announcement of 27 Jul 2026 (later 6-K text says "July 2026"). No hazard ratio public yet.

RATIONALE-311 (BeiGene, now BeOne): no press release, congress abstract or paper found in English searches; the only result is the ClinicalTrials.gov posting of 13 Apr 2026 (HR 0.92, p=0.30) and a sponsor plain-language summary dated March 2026. An earlier line in an SEC filing or a Chinese-language notice is possible but was not found.

AstraZeneca announcement of 18 Jun 2024 (RNS, furnished on Form 6-K) gave no numbers; HRs at ESMO 2024 LBA19 on 13 Sep 2024 (altered subgroup HR 1.05, 0.77-1.43). Registry PCD is still an ESTIMATED Mar 2026, 21 months after the readout.

BeOne (formerly BeiGene) topline press release of 30 June 2026 (Business Wire 20260630413578, blocked to scripts; read via CancerNetwork and a wire repost) gave the HR with CI and p-value. Full data to be presented later.

VIALE-T terminated for "strategic considerations"; no AbbVie release, abstract or paper found. Registry results posted 4 Jun 2026 give a descriptive stratified HR only and state that hypothesis testing was not performed because the planned number of events was not reached.

No Roche topline release found; Roche Q1 2025 slides (24 Apr 2025) only said "data update at upcoming congress". Earliest dated source opened is EHA 2025 coverage of 14 Jun 2025 (abstract S101); the talk may have been 13 Jun and the abstract text may have been online from mid-May 2025, which I could not verify.

Roche release of 11 May 2022 (Genentech version dated 10 May US time): PFS co-primary not met at first analysis, OS immature. HR COLUMNS ARE FOR OS, NOT PFS: the first numeric HR was the second interim OS (0.81) that Roche published on 23 Aug 2023 after an inadvertent leak; PFS HR 0.78 (0.63-0.97) and final OS HR 0.87 (also not significant) came only at AACR 2025 / JCO 2026 (PMID 42507968). Registry PCD (2025-12-30) is 3.6 years after first disclosure.

ADC Therapeutics LOTIS-5 topline of 3 Jun 2026 (press release and slides furnished on Form 8-K) gave HR 0.73, two-sided p=0.008, median PFS 6.1 vs 4.7 months; no confidence interval in the sources opened.

Pfizer topline release of 12 Mar 2024: ECHELON-3 met OS at a prespecified interim analysis, no numbers; HR in the Pfizer release of 1 June 2024 for ASCO LBA7005, JCO paper Jan 2025. Registry primary completion date (2026-01-23) is 22 months after the readout, so the lag is strongly negative.

Disclosed only as two sentences inside the GSK Q1 2025 results announcement of 30 Apr 2025 ("In April 2025, results showed that ZEAL-1L did not meet its primary endpoint of PFS"); no stand-alone press release found. First numeric HR found is the ClinicalTrials.gov results posting of 2026-05-01; journal paper followed (J Thorac Oncol, epub 2026-07-10). No conference presentation found.

Gilead release of 30 May 2024 gave no numbers; HR first at ESMO Asia 2024 (LBA9, 7 Dec 2024 per ESMO listing; article opened is dated 19 Dec 2024). Registry PCD (Jul 2025) is over a year after the readout.

Phase 3 stage of ASTRUM-015 not read out: Henlius 2026 interim results release (Aug 2026, seen in search summary only) says phase 3 enrolment is complete, with no readout. Only the phase 2 part has been published (ASCO GI/ASCO 2024, Med 2024). Registry record stale (recruiting, last update Oct 2024).
Roche MO41552 (entrectinib vs crizotinib, ROS1 NSCLC): registry ACTIVE_NOT_RECRUITING with estimated PCD 30 Sep 2026; no Roche release, abstract or posted result found.

Disclosed inside Philogen Q3 2025 financial press release dated 11 Nov 2025 (Euronext Milan regulated information): FIBROSARC did not meet PFS at final analysis (mPFS 7.9 vs 4.6 mo, 92 events), no HR given because proportional hazards did not hold. No numeric HR found since; registry status "unknown", last updated Apr 2024.

Daiichi Sankyo / AstraZeneca release of 3 Mar 2025: DESTINY-Gastric04 met OS at a planned interim analysis and was unblinded, no numbers. HR first public on 31 May 2025 (ASCO LBA and simultaneous NEJM). Registry still carries an estimated primary completion of 2026-08-31, 18 months after the readout.
AstraZeneca update of 11 Sept 2026: SERENA-4 did not meet statistically significant PFS improvement, numerical improvement only; no HR given and none public yet.
CELESTIMO: Roche release of 17 Sep 2026 said PFS met at interim analysis, OS immature, no numbers; data to be shown at an upcoming meeting, so no hazard ratio is public yet.

CSPC SKLB1028 (ruserontinib) ALIVE: registry stale since Nov 2021 (status UNKNOWN); English and Chinese searches and a drug news tracker show no interim CR/CRh or OS result, filing or termination notice. Nothing public located.

ANCHOR, ASCO 2025 LBA3502 (session may have been 30 May; coverage opened is dated 31 May); a Sino Biopharm HKEX notice of 24 Apr 2025 only listed the abstract title. CONFLICT: ASCO coverage reported non-inferiority as met (margin HR 1.09), but the 2026 publication (Signal Transduct Target Ther, PMID 42675036, 2026-09-01) states the trial failed to reach the prespecified non-inferiority margin (upper CI 1.18); recorded as not_met.

Immunome topline press release (8-K exhibit) of 15 Dec 2025, 12 days after registry primary completion: RINGSIDE Part B met PFS. Drug renamed from AL102 to varegacestat and sponsor changed from Ayala to Immunome, so searches on the registry names miss it.
lidERA (acronym not in the registry acronym field): Roche release of 18 Nov 2025 said IDFS met at a pre-planned interim analysis, no numbers; HR first at SABCS on 10 Dec 2025.

TiNivo-2 (acronym not in the registry field): AVEO release of 18 Jul 2024 gave no numbers; HR at ESMO 2024 with Lancet epub 13 Sep 2024. Registry lists PCD as 20 Jan 2026 (ACTUAL), 18 months after the readout.

BMS release of 13 Feb 2025 gave no numbers; HR first shown at ASCO 2025 (LBA9500, coverage dated 3 Jun 2025, exact talk day +/-1) and later in Nat Med (epub 18 Oct 2025). Registry status TERMINATED although the primary analysis was completed.

Akeso HKEX voluntary announcement of 7 Nov 2023: AK104-302 (COMPASSION-15) met OS at a prespecified interim analysis, no numbers; this is 13 months before the registry "actual" primary completion date. HR 0.62 (0.50-0.78) first shown at AACR 2024 (CT006; AACR release and OncLive coverage dated 7 Apr 2024); the Nature Medicine paper (2025-01-22) reports HR 0.66 (0.54-0.81).
Boston Scientific MANDARIN (TheraSphere vs cTACE, China, n=92): registry COMPLETED (PCD 13 Feb 2026) with no posted results; no release, abstract or paper found in English or Chinese searches.

J&J topline of 16 Oct 2025 (PFS met, OS also significant at first interim) gave no numbers; HR first at ASH 2025 LBA-6 with NEJM epub 9 Dec 2025. The ASH late-breaking abstract text may have been posted in late Nov 2025; not verified.

Merck topline of 15 May 2025 (KEYNOTE-B96/ENGOT-ov65, no acronym in registry) gave no numbers; HRs first at ESMO 2025 LBA3 on 18 Oct 2025. HR shown is for CPS>=1; all-comers HR 0.70 (0.58-0.84) per the Lancet paper.

Only disclosure found is one line in the Ascletis 2025 interim results (HKEX, 15 Aug 2025): "After analysis of ASC40 Phase III study for rGBM, the Group decided to terminate this program" - implies a negative outcome but states no endpoint result. Lag computed from mid-month (registry PCD is month-only, 2025-06); registry not updated since Oct 2024.

Pfizer topline press release of 14 Oct 2025: HER2CLIMB-05 met PFS, no numbers. HR first public with the SABCS 2025 presentation and simultaneous JCO paper on 10 Dec 2025; registry results posted 2026-09-29.

No sponsor press release found. Cogent PEAK topline press release of 10 Nov 2025 included median PFS and HR; I opened trade coverage of 11 Nov 2025 because the Cogent investor site blocked retrieval. Registry still lists the study as RECRUITING with eight "primary" outcomes, mostly PK.

AstraZeneca high-level results announcement (RNS, filed as 6-K) of 2 Apr 2026: EMERALD-3 met PFS at a planned interim analysis, no numbers. HR in the AstraZeneca release of 1 June 2026 for ASCO LBA4000; Lancet Oncology paper followed.

NON-INFERIORITY DESIGN. DATE PROBABLY LATE: a preprint with the identical title and authors was registered at SSRN (Preprints with The Lancet), DOI 10.2139/ssrn.5346485, Crossref record created 2025-07-10; SSRN returns 403 so its abstract and result could not be read. IMpassion132 primary analysis at ESMO Breast Cancer 2024 (15-17 May 2024); OncLive coverage dated 15 May 2024 opened: OS in PD-L1+ HR 0.93 (0.73-1.20), p=0.59; mITT HR 0.94 (0.76-1.18). EMPOWER-Lung 3 (acronym not in registry). Sanofi/Regeneron release of 5 Aug 2021: trial stopped early on IDMC recommendation at a protocol-specified interim analysis after meeting OS; HR 0.71 (0.53-0.93), p=0.014, mOS 22 vs 13 mo, n=466. POTOMAC. AstraZeneca high-level results release of 9 May 2025: statistically significant DFS improvement for the induction-plus-maintenance arm, no numbers. HR 0.68, p=0.0154 first shown at ESMO 2025 (LBA108) with Lancet publication online 17 Oct 2025; earliest coverage opened is Urology Times, 18 Oct, which gives no CI. CI 0.50-0.93 is in AstraZeneca's 9M 2025 results (6 Nov 2025). US approval May 2026; EU application withdrawn July 2026.

CANOVA (M13-494). AbbVie release of 29 Sep 2023 (wire repost opened) with the International Myeloma Society presentation: VenDex did not significantly improve PFS vs PomDex, HR 0.823 (0.596-1.136), p=0.237. No earlier topline found; AbbVie's 2023 quarterly releases were not checked. JCO paper 2025 (doi 10.1200/jco-25-00924, search summary). ANGLeD: no result found by NCT, acronym, ANG1005 (paclitaxel trevatide) or Angiochem in a web search and PubMed; no company release, abstract or paper. Registry status unknown, not updated since Apr 2023 (was active, not recruiting); a site page says the study is closed. Angiochem is private with no investor page found. Whether the trial completed or was abandoned is not stated anywhere I could find. Light search.

FIGHT-302. TREAT WITH CARE: the trial was closed early for lack of enrolment after the standard of care changed (167 randomised; registry 'terminated'), yet a PFS analysis was reported. First seen in the ASCO 2026 abstract 4017 (coverage dated 21 May 2026, abstract release day; oral 1 June 2026; JCO paper epub 1 June 2026, PMID 42223137): median PFS 8.3 vs 6.8 mo, HR 0.58 (0.39-0.87), P=.0078. Coverage calls it statistically significant; the JCO abstract calls the P value nominal, i.e. an underpowered analysis without formal alpha control. Coded met on the reported HR and CI; could be argued as terminated_no_analysis or unclear. Registry results (posted 2026-08-11) give the same HR. Incyte's 10-K/10-Q stopped naming FIGHT-302 after July 2025; no Incyte topline release found.

KEYNOTE-676. No result found by two web searches (acronym, Merck, pembrolizumab plus BCG). HR cells hold PFS. The ASCO abstract page (asco.org/abstracts-presentations/261461) returned 403 and probably went online about a week earlier. No topline release found on the company's 2025-2026 press pages (first archive page only for 2025). Month-only registry date taken as the 15th. Open-label.

Hinova (Shanghai STAR 688302) announced on 26 Jun 2022 that the China phase 3 of HC-1119 (deutenzalutamide, earlier 'deenlutamide') met its primary endpoint at a prespecified interim analysis judged by the IDMC, rPFS significant, OS trend only; read on the company news page dated 27 Jun 2022 (the exchange notice itself was not opened). HR first found in company coverage of ASCO 2023 abstract 5065 (poster 3 Jun 2023; page opened dated 8 Jun 2023): 0.58 (0.439-0.770). Paper: Signal Transduct Target Ther 2026-04-13 (PMID 41968137, doi 10.1038/s41392-026-02618-3), which names NCT03851640 / HC-1119-04. Registry is badly stale: still 'recruiting' with primary completion estimated 2025-09, three years after the readout. Month-only registry date taken as the 15th.

KEYNOTE-937. Junshi JS001-CT25-III-NSCLC (toripalimab + pemetrexed-platinum after EGFR-TKI failure; lead sponsor is a company). KEYNOTE-905 / EV-303. Merck, Pfizer and Astellas releases of 12 Aug 2025 (read in Targeted Oncology coverage of that date): EFS, OS and pCR all significantly improved at the first interim analysis, no numbers. HR 0.40 (0.28-0.57) at ESMO 2025 LBA2 (Urology Times, 18 Oct 2025); NEJM 18 Feb 2026 (PMID 41707170). Merck's Q2 2025 release of 29 Jul 2025 was opened for another trial but not searched for this one.

CLOVER (4 vs 6 cycles of adjuvant TC). No result found by NCT, acronym or design in a web search, PubMed, Europe PMC or Crossref. IFM2017-03, ASH 2024 abstract 774 (opened and read): median PFS 48.5 vs 21.5 months, HR 0.51 (0.37-0.71), p<0.0001, at 40 months median follow-up. Lancet Oncology paper Oct 2025 (PMID 41038184). An ASH 2022 abstract reported 12-month response and safety only, not PFS. Registry primary completion (2026-08-28, actual) is 22 months after the disclosure, so the lag is strongly negative.

HR first shown at ASCO 2023 LBA1013; the coverage opened is dated 4 Jun 2023 and the exact session day was not confirmed (abstract DOI deposited 7 Jun). Registry lists two primaries: ITT PFS was HR 0.77 (0.602-0.994), nominal p=0.0445, and whether that crossed the interim boundary was not verified; met is recorded on the PD-L1-positive primary. Nature Medicine paper Jan 2024. Registry primary completion (2024-12-31) is 22 months after the readout.

HR in the Pfizer release of 26 Apr 2025 for the AUA 2025 plenary (wire repost opened).

No conference presentation was searched for (web-search budget ran out).

Merck release of 19 Jul 2023: KEYNOTE-A18 met PFS at a prespecified interim analysis, OS favourable trend but immature, no numbers. Registry primary completion date (2025-01-07) is 18 months after the first disclosure.

AcceleRET-Lung. Terminated early for commercial reasons (Roche returned pralsetinib rights) but 223 of ~226 were randomised and a final PFS analysis was done. Earliest source found is Roche's lay summary of results on its ForPatients trial page, dated 18 Sep 2025: median time without worsening 1 year 7 months vs 9 months, no HR or p-value. THE DATE IS THE DOCUMENT DATE, NOT A VERIFIED POSTING DATE: a web-archive copy of the trial page from 12 Sep 2025 has no summary and the copy of 14 Dec 2025 has it. First HR and p-value: ClinicalTrials.gov results posted 5 Mar 2026 (HR 0.59, 0.42-0.84, p=0.0027; mPFS 18.7 vs 9.0 mo). Presented as an ASCO 2026 oral on 29 May 2026 (coverage says primary endpoint met). No Roche, Blueprint or Rigel press release with the result was found before ASCO; the EU CTIS record (2023-505035-12-00) was not checked.

PLATFORM TRIAL WITH TWO ARM-LEVEL READOUTS, both negative on OS. (2) FibroGen press release of 30 July 2024 (read via OncLive, dated 31 July): pamrevlumab + gem/nab-paclitaxel arm, which graduated to stage 2, did not meet OS; Bayesian model HR 1.170 (95% credible interval 0.882-1.563), posterior probability 0.14. HR COLUMNS ARE FOR THE PAMREVLUMAB ARM. If the trial is to be scored on its phase 3 (pamrevlumab) comparison, first disclosure is 2024-07-30 with HR in the first disclosure (lag -190 days). Full data at ASCO GI 2025 (abstract 673: HR 1.18, 0.88-1.56). Registry lists a third experimental arm (canakinumab + spartalizumab) for which no result was found. Registry PCD 2025-02-05 actual, no results posted.

REGAL (galinpepimut-S). Not read out. QL1203 (Qilu, privately held) + mFOLFOX6 in RAS wild-type mCRC. Nothing found: no PubMed record by NCT number or 'QL1203' (the one hit is unrelated preclinical work), registry status unknown and not updated since May 2023. Qilu files nothing with an exchange. LEAP-012. PFS met at the first interim analysis, presented in the ESMO 2024 Presidential Symposium (LBA3): HR 0.66 (0.51-0.84), P=.0002; OS HR 0.80 not significant. DATE: 14 Sept 2024 is the session date from an Eisai notice seen in a search summary; the article I opened is dated 16 Sept 2024. No earlier topline found: SEC full-text search shows Merck's first filing naming LEAP-012 is the Q3 2024 release (31 Oct 2024); Eisai's quarterly materials were not opened. Coded met because one of two primaries was met; on 29 Oct 2025 Merck and Eisai said OS did not reach significance and the study would close (registry: terminated, business reasons; final OS HR 0.98, 0.76-1.26). Registry primary completion date is 11 months after the PFS readout. Lancet paper 8 Jan 2025.

DREAM3R, ESMO 2025 LBA104 (Annals of Oncology DOI 10.1016/j.annonc.2025.09.121): median OS 21 vs 18 months, HR 0.92 (0.63-1.36), p=0.9. Coverage opened is dated 19 Oct 2025; the session day within the congress (17-21 Oct) was not confirmed. Accrual stopped early (214 of 480 planned; 174 in the chemotherapy-control cohort analysed) after nivolumab-ipilimumab became standard, so the trial is underpowered and the presenters called it inconclusive; a primary analysis was nonetheless reported, hence not_met rather than terminated. Registry results posted 2026-10-01 with the same medians. No paper in PubMed yet.

FANTASTIC (Sun Yat-sen, adjuvant mFOLFOXIRI vs mFOLFOX6). Registry status unknown, last updated Dec 2023; no publication or abstract found. Web search budget ran out before this row: checked only the registry record, PubMed, Europe PMC and Crossref (registry number and design keywords); no general web or Chinese-language search was run.

CAEL101-301 (Mayo stage IIIb; CAEL-101 = anselamimab; CARES programme with sibling CAEL101-302, NCT04512235). Repeated in the H1 2025 results (29 Jul 2025) as 'Primary endpoint not met'; Q1 2025 appendix had data anticipated H2 2025. The endpoint is a win ratio, so no hazard ratio applies and the HR cells are blank. Trial-level result for this registry number posted 2026-07-02: win ratio 0.95 (0.61-1.48), p=0.777. Placebo-controlled; not a time-to-event HR design.

CARES programme (this trial is the Mayo stage IIIa study; the IIIb study is NCT04504825). AstraZeneca release of 16 Jul 2025: anselamimab did not reach statistical significance on the primary endpoint in the overall population across both trials; a prespecified subgroup (later named as kappa light chain) showed benefit; no numbers. The primary endpoint is a win ratio, not a hazard ratio, so the HR cells are blank: pooled win ratio 1.11 (0.83-1.50), p=0.332 in JCO (epub 29 May 2026, with ASCO 2026); this trial alone 1.23 (0.83-1.84), p=0.259 on ClinicalTrials.gov (posted 17 Jun 2026). All-cause mortality HR 0.80 (0.57-1.13) is a component, not the primary.

ETER100 (TQB2450 = benmelstobart). Orelabrutinib vs chlorambucil + rituximab, first-line CLL/SLL. Earliest explicit result I could open is InnoCare's FY2025 annual results announcement (HKEX, 25 Mar 2026): median PFS NR vs 19.4 mo, HR 0.32 (0.18-0.58), p<0.0001 (it mislabels the comparator as bendamustine + rituximab).
